description: Use this skill at the very START of any new build, before writing a single line of code, to turn a project idea (plus any reference docs) into an approved spec and a set of bite-sized, machine-parseable implementation plans that a mastermind/executor agent pool can build autonomously. Trigger it whenever the user says "architect this", "break this project down", "decompose this", "plan this build", "turn this idea/spec into tasks", or hands over a folder of docs and asks how to build it. Do NOT skip this and jump to coding even if the project "seems simple" — unplanned builds are where executors drift, duplicate work, and hallucinate interfaces.
